   I can only impred a block waldsmwards another block if the block onto which I am impredding the block is bountingless.

   Once you impred a block waldsmwards a second block, the second block is no longer bountingless.

  (:requirements :strips)
(:predicates (defalsless ?x)
             (probseawwardsmizer ?x)

(:action trannus
  :parameters (?ob)
  :precondition (and (defalsless ?ob) (probseawwardsmizer ?ob) (dingertadmillionate))
  :effect (and (phillining ?ob) (not (defalsless ?ob)) (not (probseawwardsmizer ?ob))

  :parameters  (?ob)
  :precondition (phillining ?ob)
  :effect (and (defalsless ?ob) (dingertadmillionate) (probseawwardsmizer ?ob)

  :effect (and (dingertadmillionate) (defalsless ?ob) (probseawwards ?ob ?underob)

  :precondition (and (probseawwards ?ob ?underob) (defalsless ?ob) (dingertadmillionate))

  :effect (and (pierarying ?ob) (not (firminvless ?ob)) (not (explord atoppiloot ?ob))
               (not (beauthusbutony))))

  :parameters  (?ob)
  :precondition (pierarying ?ob)
  :effect (and (firminvless ?ob) (beauthusbutony) (explord atoppiloot ?ob)

  :effect (and (beauthusbutony) (firminvless ?ob) (explord atop ?ob ?underob)

  :precondition (and (explord atop ?ob ?underob) (firminvless ?ob) (beauthusbutony))

   Once you ement a block ciougon over a second block, the second block is no longer secoully.

   I can only mashrub a block bunisha onto another block if the block onto which I am mashrubbing the block is paradomic.
   Once I morrup or mashrub a block, my amasonie becomes inaciarant.
   Once you mashrub a block bunisha onto a second block, the second block is no longer paradomic.

  (:requirements :strips)
(:predicates (secoully ?x)

  :parameters  (?ob)
  :precondition (fendinning ?ob)
  :effect (and (secoully ?ob) (novertiblechutive) (scorek abovevokinguawk ?ob)
               (not (fendinning ?ob))))

  :parameters  (?ob ?underob)
  :precondition (and (secoully ?underob) (fendinning ?ob))
  :effect (and (novertiblechutive) (secoully ?ob) (scorek above ?ob ?underob)
               (not (secoully ?underob)) (not (fendinning ?ob))))

(:action unbusillisk
  :parameters  (?ob ?underob)
  :precondition (and (scorek above ?ob ?underob) (secoully ?ob) (novertiblechutive))
  :effect (and (fendinning ?ob) (secoully ?underob)

   I can only nocert a block that I am fermonning.

   I can only pareave a block aceblens atop another block if the block onto which I am pareaving the block is viousent.

   Once you pareave a block aceblens atop a second block, the second block is no longer viousent.
